Subject: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission details

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding touchpoint last week. Finance asked me to confirm the exact requirements for submitting invoices to Redwood so we can update our AP system. A couple of things we need clarified before we roll out automated submissions: 

- Preferred channel: portal vs. email. If portal, do you support API push or SFTP? If email, what subject tokens do you use to route?
- PO stamping: do you need the PO number in the filename, metadata, or both?
- Required fields: ledger/account code, department, project code — are there exact column names you expect for CSV ingestion?
- Accepted formats: PDF, single-line CSV, or multi-line CSV with line-level GL mapping?

We can attach our current invoice export (CSV) and a sample PDF. Attaching our supplier onboarding form as requested.

Attachments: invoice_sample_lines.csv (CSV), vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (fillable PDF)

Goal is to automate submission by May 20. Can you confirm the acceptance criteria and any fallback rules in case the portal is down?

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear list and for sending the sample files. Quick responses inline below, then I loop in Rishi for the ledger mapping specifics we need from Finance.

- Preferred channel: We prefer the vendor portal for automated onboarding (API push or SFTP ingestion). Portal gives faster ACKs and better parsing reliability.
- Email fallback: allowed when portal is unavailable. To route reliably, set subject prefix: [RDW-INVOICE] followed by PO (e.g., [RDW-INVOICE] PO-12345). We also require the PDF/CSV attached; no links-only emails.
- PO stamping: PO number must appear in the filename (PO-12345_invoice.pdf) AND in an invoice metadata row/field. This helps our automatic matching engine with PO-stamped invoices.
- CSV columns: Required column names are EXACT (case-insensitive): invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, currency, po_number, line_description, line_amount, account_code, department_code, project_code. If you want, use the attached vendor_onboarding_form_v2 to map your export to our template.
- Formats: we accept PDF (single-invoice), single-line CSV (one invoice per row) or line-level CSV (multiple rows per invoice). For line-level CSV ensure invoice_number repeats on each line.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (fillable)

Fallback rules when portal is down (high level):
1) Email fallback with subject prefix [RDW-INVOICE] and PO in subject.
2) If email also fails, SFTP drop to a pre-shared folder (contact Ops to provision folder).
3) For urgent credits/payments attach a one-line email to AP ops with CC to procurement.

Next: Rishi — can you confirm whether the account_code list below (excerpt) aligns with Finance and whether we should require a GL segment for 'cost_center' as well? If yes, we'll add it to the onboarding form.

Thanks,
Monica

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-02T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice submission details

Thanks Monica — quick technical confirmation from Finance side. Excerpt of required ledger mapping rules: 

- account_code: 6-digit GL (mandatory)
- department_code: 3-digit cost center optional for vendors that bill multiple teams; if missing we'll default to '000' and route to procurement for clarification.
- project_code: optional, but if present must match an active project id in our ERP. We can validate via API lookup during ingest; if invalid, invoice will be flagged and moved to manual review.
- currency: must be ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR)

Important: for automated matching we need either the account_code present on the invoice file or the PO line-level mapping. If neither present, the invoice will be rejected by the automated pipeline and returned with a rejection reason.

On fallback behaviour: prefer email fallback as Monica described. Note two operational caveats:
- When portal is down, batch email submissions are acceptable but each invoice must be a separate attachment or clearly demarcated in CSV with invoice_number column.
- Email drops should be limited to one per vendor per day for automated ingestion; more frequent drops create duplicates. For high-volume partners we'll open a dedicated SFTP/API pathway.

I've attached a small mapping cheat-sheet to share with Acme (I can paste it into the portal help center). If you want, we can require vendor sign-off on the onboarding form stating they will maintain filename and metadata standards.

Rishi
Finance Systems Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Ava — quick summary and next steps so everyone is aligned. Please use this as the implementation checklist when your AP team configures automated submissions.

Acceptance criteria for automated ingestion (all must be true):
- File arrives via Portal API, SFTP drop, or Email with subject prefix [RDW-INVOICE] and PO included in subject.
- Filename includes PO number: PO-xxxxx_invoice.pdf or PO-xxxxx_invoice.csv.
- CSV column names match our template (invoice_number, invoice_date, total_amount, currency, po_number, line_description, line_amount, account_code, department_code, project_code).
- account_code (6-digit GL) present or PO line-level mapping provided.
- No password-protected PDFs; attachments must be machine-readable.

Fallback rules (operational):
1) Portal outage window: use email with prefix [RDW-INVOICE]. Attach each invoice as individual file OR a single CSV with invoice_number column. Limit to 1 email/day for automated ingestion.
2) If email is also unavailable, contact procurement@redwood.com to request temporary SFTP credentials.
3) For urgent disputes/payments include 'URGENT' in subject after the prefix: [RDW-INVOICE][URGENT]. This routes to AP ops immediately.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (please complete page 2 mapping sections), invoice_sample_lines.csv (example of line-level CSV layout).

Next steps for Acme:
- Confirm you can produce invoice filenames with PO embedded and that your export maps to the attached CSV column names by Friday, May 6.
- If you need SFTP credentials, reply to this thread and we'll provision once procurement authorises it.

If you confirm, Vanessa will send the portal onboarding link and Rishi will publish the mapping cheat-sheet to the vendor help center.

Thanks,
Monica
